column10: Both Witnesses stand near central Archives pedestal in Beat J pose. Enigma is a half-step behind and to the Antiquarian's left. Her hands are clasped loosely at her waist. She does NOT turn when the player enters.

antiq_text_preview: You came back. That is the part we were not certain of.
notes: GAZE #1. Eye-line lifts from pedestal, finds the player, held ~1.5s, returns to the floor.

antiq_text_preview: I was executed for what I thought. I woke up in the next era.
notes: Motionless. The confession is the Antiquarian's alone.

antiq_text_preview: Across Ages. Across the death of stars. I have been waiting…
notes: On the word 'waiting' — 300ms subtle weight shift from one foot to the other. Acknowledges the pronoun 'I' is also hers. Not a gesture; a settling.

antiq_text_preview: The song you heard a few minutes ago. It was recorded a very long time ago…
notes: Head does NOT turn toward the Antiquarian. Face softens around the eyes for ~500ms — a private recognition of her own song. No other movement.

antiq_text_preview: He was not one of us. His death is the shape.
notes: Smallest possible nod, exactly once, on the phrase 'his death is the shape.' Not confirmation — acknowledgment.

antiq_text_preview: The voice you heard carrying his words — she also died for what she thought.
notes: Eye-line crosses briefly to the Antiquarian on 'the voice you heard', confirming his framing of her, then returns forward. She does NOT look at the player on this line.

antiq_text_preview: She has chosen silence tonight. You will hear her voice again when she is ready.
notes: GAZE #2. Longest gaze of the scene. Held through the entire line (~5s). Her own answer to the Antiquarian's promise.

antiq_text_preview: So: what was begun in him, carried by her, now waits. In you.
notes: Eye-line still on the player from l07. Posture unchanged. Sustained hold from the previous beat — does NOT count as a separate gaze.

antiq_text_preview: A thing was begun, and it has not finished. It can continue… or it can end here, in this room, with us.
notes: On the word 'end', gaze drifts off the player to the middle distance. The player should feel her looking away as consequence.

antiq_text_preview: Will you carry it?
notes: Motionless. Both Witnesses still. UI fades in on shared silence.

antiq_text_preview: Then we have not waited in vain. Go carefully.
notes: On the Antiquarian's first syllable, eye-line returns to the player. Held 3s sustained. No smile. This is a BRIDGE to gaze #3 on l14 — does not count against the gaze budget.

antiq_text_preview: Then we will wait longer. We have learned how.
notes: One glance to the Antiquarian, then back to the floor. Posture sags very slightly — the specific tiredness of someone who has waited before and will wait again.

antiq_text_preview: Ask, then. Tonight, an answer costs nothing.
notes: Eye-line stays on the middle distance. Patient, neutral. Shows no preference about what the player will ask.

antiq_text_preview: What we are is not the question. What you do with what you have heard tonight — that is the question.
notes: Motionless throughout the catch-all. Canon-safe fallback blocking.

antiq_text_preview: (who was he?) He was an engineer. He kept one name at the end — the Prince.
notes: ONE PERMITTED PHYSICAL GESTURE. On the words 'the Prince', the Enigma's clasped hands compress for ~200ms (finger pressure, not a reposition). Face unchanged. This is the ONLY time in the scene she physically reacts to a name.

antiq_text_preview: (how long waiting?) Long enough that the word itself has worn smooth.
notes: Motionless. She is the answer the Antiquarian is speaking.

antiq_text_preview: (what if I say no?) Then the work continues without you for a little longer.
notes: EXTRA GAZE — counts against the 3-gaze budget. Eye-line rises to the player once, ~1s, then back. A silent 'we will be here' without the Antiquarian's words. TRIGGERS the gaze #3 shortening rule on l14.

antiq_text_preview: (why me?) You are not chosen. It always turns out to be enough.
notes: On the closing clause 'it always turns out to be enough', her chin lifts a fraction — the smallest possible nod. Second nod of the scene (first was l05).

antiq_text_preview: We will be here. We have nowhere else we are expected to be.
notes: Holds position. No movement. Shared close line.

antiq_text_preview: We will be here. We have nowhere else we are expected to be.
notes: Eye-line on the pedestal — not on the player or the Antiquarian. Decline-branch posture sag carries through.

antiq_text_preview: End of memoir. The next breath is yours.
notes: GAZE #3. Fires on time, held through the fade to black. Default duration. Her eyes are the last image before the 'End of Act 1' title card.

antiq_text_preview: End of memoir. The next breath is yours.
notes: GAZE #3. Starts from the floor and arrives mid-fade — slower lift than the accept variant. The fade catches her eyes mid-arrival; she never fully finishes the gaze before black. This is the emotional signature of the decline branch.

antiq_text_preview: End of memoir. The next breath is yours.
notes: GAZE #3. Default duration. Canon-safe for all deflect variants EXCEPT v3.
